descriptionHtml:
TP-Link TL-WA855RE Detailed Specifications

  • Hardware Interface: 1x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet Port (RJ45)

  • Form Factor: Wall-Plug Design

  • Wireless Standards: IEEE 802.11n, IEEE 802.11g, IEEE 802.11b (Wi-Fi 4)

  • Frequency Band: 2.4 GHz (2.4 ~ 2.4835 GHz)

  • Maximum Signal Rate: Up to 300 Mbps (Dynamic)

  • Antenna Type: 2x External Antennas (with MIMO Technology)

  • Transmit Power: < 20 dBm (EIRP)

  • Wireless Security: 64/128/152-bit WEP, WPA-PSK / WPA2-PSK

  • Working Modes: * Range Extender Mode: Boosts existing wireless signal to dead zones.

    • Access Point (AP) Mode: Turns a wired internet connection into a wireless Wi-Fi hotspot.

  • Physical Buttons: 1x WPS (Range Extender) Button, 1x Reset Button

  • LED Indicator: Smart Signal Indicator (Blue = Good connection, Red = Too far from router)

  • Advanced Software Features: Power Schedule (Energy saving), Access Control (Device blacklisting), Wi-Fi Coverage Control, Tether App Management (iOS/Android)

  • Power Consumption: ~3.6 W

  • Dimensions: 80 mm x 77.8 mm x 77.3 mm (3.15" x 3.06" x 3.04")
